patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ecwid and PrestaShop share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Ecwid and PrestaShop share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Ecwid only if your buying job matches “Embeddable storefront you add to an existing site — Starter $5/mo, Venture $29 annual, Bus” rather than PrestaShop's shape. Choose PrestaShop only if your buying job matches “Open-source PHP commerce — Classic free; Hosted from ~$26/mo annual (€24 excl. VAT) with 1” rather than Ecwid's shape. Workflow advantage: Ecwid leans checkout-conversion; PrestaShop leans catalog-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ecwid and PrestaShop share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Ecwid is Embeddable storefront you add to an existing site — Starter $5/mo, Venture $29 annual, Business $49, Unlimited $119 (post 2 Mar 2026 tiles);; PrestaShop is Open-source PHP commerce — Classic free; Hosted from ~$26/mo annual (€24 excl. VAT) with 14-day trial; Enterprise quote. WooCommerce keeps t.
- Company-size focus: Ecwid (solo, micro, small-business) vs PrestaShop (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Ecwid-leaning checkout-conversion vs PrestaShop-leaning catalog-management.
- Researched limits: Ecwid — Catalog, B2B, and checkout depth trail Shopify-class commerce OS products; PrestaShop — Classic TCO (hosting, modules, agency) is not $0 even when the license is free.

Limitations — Ecwid: Catalog, B2B, and checkout depth trail Shopify-class commerce OS products; POS / omnichannel is limited versus Lightspeed Retail or Square; PrestaShop: Classic TCO (hosting, modules, agency) is not $0 even when the license is free; POS / omnichannel is module-dependent, not a native retail bundle.

Poor-fit cases: Ecwid is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Catalog, B2B, and checkout depth trail Shopify-class commerce OS products · PrestaShop is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Classic TCO (hosting, modules, agency) is not $0 even when the license is free · Avoid Ecwid if you actually need PrestaShop's motion (Open-source PHP commerce — Classic free; Hosted from ~$26/mo annual (€24 excl. V)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
